verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details LangGraph's graph execution, checkpointing, persistence, streaming, human-in-the-loop interrupts, and deployment via CLI/LangSmith, but nothing describes scheduling recurring jobs or cron-like triggering of workflows. Since workflow orchestration platforms plausibly could offer such scheduling, this is an applicable axis with no supporting evidence. Missing for 10: any mention of cron/recurring triggers, scheduled runs, or time-based automation in LangGraph or LangGraph Platform docs.
